entries.zh: 驾船；驾驶舟船行驶
entries.en: to steer a ship, take a vessel under way (llevar el navío)

entries.zh: 寄去；托人捎带（信件、物件）过去
entries.en: to send (a letter or goods) off with someone; carry over for delivery

entries.zh: 寄得稳、不寄失；寄送时当心不使遗失
entries.en: to send a thing with care so that it is not lost (no se pierda)

entries.zh: 寄放在（人）手上；托付保管
entries.en: to put into someone's hands; entrust and leave in another's keeping

entries.zh: 施恩；赐予恩惠
entries.en: to bestow grace or favor; (Spanish) to provide for the soul
entries.notes: M 栏标[残]，西语 proveerse el ánimo 与施恩对应不直，释义主要依汉字施恩，存疑。

entries.zh: 递文书；递送书信、公函
entries.en: to carry and deliver letters or documents (el correo); dispatch the mail

entries.zh: 驾舵驶去；把船驶往外海
entries.en: to steer the ship out; take a vessel off to sea
entries.notes: 汉字舵伊去解析为驾舵而去、西语尾部 o nuevo~ 未确解，释义含推断。

entries.zh: 传话；捎带口信
entries.en: to carry a message; pass on word (recado)

entries.zh: 转回头、转身；（商货）随回程船载返
entries.en: to turn back; to carry merchandise on the return voyage of the trade (galleon contratación)
entries.notes: 转头尾（回返）与西语回程贩运（buela de la contratación）取回返义接合，释义含推断。

entries.zh: 有志气；有志将已开始之事进行到底
entries.en: to have spirit and ambition; to carry forward what has been begun

entries.zh: 夹在腋下携带；或训夺去（四栏不合，释义存疑）
entries.en: to carry something under the arm; possibly to snatch it away (columns conflict)
entries.notes: 汉字加奪与西语夹于腋下携带对应不合（夺亦可训夺去），两义无法定夺。

entries.zh: 牵手；牵着（人）手行走
entries.en: to lead someone by the hand; take by the hand

entries.zh: 载上载落；装上船又卸下来
entries.en: to carry aboard (load on) and bring down (unload)

entries.zh: 进膳；进呈御膳（为君王进送饭食）
entries.en: to present the king's meal; serve in the royal repast

entries.zh: 娶妻、娶某；男子娶妇带回家中
entries.en: (of a husband) to take a wife, marry and bring her home
entries.notes: M 栏 choa bon 合于闽南语娶某（娶妻），与西语丈夫娶妻带回家相合；H 栏焦人疑为娶某之误读，释义含推断。

entries.zh: 出山；出殡送葬，抬死者上山安葬
entries.en: to carry the dead out to the mountain for burial; funeral procession

entries.zh: 奉命；奉命传话、领命而行
entries.en: to bear a message or command under orders (Spanish truncated)
entries.notes: L 栏标[残]且截断（Llevar recado~），释义主要依汉字奉命。

entries.zh: 驾驭骏马；策马而行
entries.en: to ride or manage a horse skillfully; lead a fine steed
entries.notes: H 首字标[疑:凌/龍]，西语 de diestro 未确解，释义含推断。

entries.zh: 手执字旗；举旗行走
entries.en: to carry the banner or standard in the hand

entries.zh: 咒语，任其耗食而去；犹言让魔鬼带走
entries.en: imprecation: may the devil take it away (let it be devoured and gone)
entries.notes: 西语为咒语 uévase el diablo（让魔鬼带走），与汉字耗食去之对应含推断。
